scope: Code and APK verification only. No new on-device generation or end-to-end latency measurement.
changes: Prepare the portable E2B engine while the foreground chat is idle, guarded by backend, ABI and RAM availability; generate no warmup answer.
Direct document responses do not wait for preparation. Semantic encoding waits for the preparation job to end before loading its encoder.
Retain the engine when only answer length settings change.
Honor explicit numbered per-item sentence requests without an introduction or repeated conclusion. Output token limits and final answer content are not truncated by this change.
Write Android JVM evaluation artifacts to app/build/reports/fieldguard instead of the project root tmp directory.

realQueryRegression.scope: Actual pinned ONNX query embeddings and production Kotlin retrieval; no device UI or Gemma generation.

latencyTarget.status: not measured after this change; not claimed achieved
latencyTarget.reason: User requested code and APK verification without a connected test phone. Preparation changes do not establish faster native decoding throughput.
